subject: Fiscal Year 2025 Preliminary Budget Reviews
overview: The committee conducted its first preliminary budget reviews for Fiscal Year 2025 under a new city ordinance, focusing on the Council on Aging, Medford Community Media, and Veterans Services. The administration noted the city is currently working to close a budget gap caused by the expiration of one-time federal ARPA and ESSER funds.

items.title: Council on Aging Budget Review
items.summary: Director Pam Kelly requested a municipal budget of $275,226.79, representing a slight increase due to union contracts and updated office equipment. The department highlighted its expanded nutrition programs and goal to increase outreach to seniors who do not currently utilize the center.

items.title: Medford Community Media Budget Review
items.summary: Station Manager Kevin Harrington proposed a budget of $204,427.37, featuring a $3,000 increase to upgrade the Video on Demand platform to a more reliable 1080p cloud-based system. The committee approved a motion to request a report from the Finance Department on PEG access fees paid to the city by Comcast and Verizon.

items.title: Veterans Services Budget Review
items.summary: Director Veronica Shaw presented a budget request of $443,552, which includes a $7,000 increase for personnel raises while ordinary expenses remain level-funded. Priorities for the upcoming year include making the department office ADA-compliant and increasing outreach to younger veterans and those facing housing insecurity.

items.title: Administrative and Election Budget Updates
items.summary: Chief of Staff Nina Nazarian alerted the council to a potential deficit in the elections budget due to unbudgeted recount costs. The administration agreed to provide departmental budget sheets for the Finance and Legislative Clerk offices prior to the next scheduled meeting.
